name: @fuaran-ui/theme-manifest
description: Machine-readable theme contract for Fuaran UI — a DTCG-compatible token model extended with semantic role bindings (which token a Tone resolves to) and quantified invariants (per-role contrast floors, 60-30-10 colour-usage budgets, motion voice). The TypeScript twin of Fuaran.UI.ThemeManifest; what the computed-style observer verifies resolved style against.
author: Andrew J. Willshire <andrew@fuaran.com> (Diametrical Ltd)
